title: NCDA warns businesses of legal consequences for rejecting PWD ID

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The National Council on Disability Affairs (NCDA) on Wednesday warned business establishments that they could face legal consequences for refusing to honor existing identification (ID) cards of persons with disabilities (PWDs), as these remain valid throughout the three-year transition period. In a statement, the NCDA clarified that the mandatory privileges and benefits granted to PWD ID holders would remain uninterrupted despite the shift to a unified PWD ID system, which aims to ensure that only qualified individuals are enrolled in the program.
